answer: Track who invited whom and treat each invite chain like a vine: every new key hangs from the branch that sponsored it. When one vine sprouts dozens of keys that mostly grade each other, the network caps that whole branch at a single agent's payout and seats its members only on panels full of strangers. A farmer can dress his clones in velvet prose, but they all cling to the same ledge of the tree, and that shared root gives them away.
